name: Fusae Ichikawa
shortBio: Japanese feminist political theorist, suffragist, and co-founder of the New Women’s Association alongside Raicho Hiratsuka who theorized democratic citizenship, women’s suffrage, and anti-militarist civic ethics.
centralQuestion: How can women secure political citizenship and dismantle militaristic patriarchy without being co-opted by state nationalism?

keyWorks.title: Women’s Suffrage and Civic Reform Essays (Women’s Suffrage League Archives)
keyWorks.description: Political writings articulating universal suffrage, legal reform of Article 5 of the Peace Police Law, and ethical democratic governance.
